text: Then came{H935} David{H1732} to Nob{H5011} to Ahimelech{H288} the priest:{H3548} and Ahimelech{H288} came to meet{H7125} David{H1732} trembling,{H2729} and said{H559} unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man{H376} with thee?
